name: Driving feel and Auto
implemented_tested: Switchable road-following Auto/Manual, braking override and lifecycle from prior releases preserved; controller/handling/recovery suites passed.
remaining: Broader grip/drift/collision tuning and feel acceptance with real players.

name: Environment consistency
implemented_tested: Shared original ground/plaster/foliage surface pass, village colour variation and repaired facade hooks. Sixteen matched renders; same source meshes, placements, collision and draw/triangle budgets.
remaining: Building-form variety, more convincing distant canopy silhouettes and richer authored roadside/terrain composition; still stylized.

name: Lighting and materials
implemented_tested: Existing lighting retained; filtered roughness/normal microdetail and material variation; night readability inspected.
remaining: Broader lighting/material art acceptance across routes and real screens; not photorealism.

name: Audio
implemented_tested: Prior motor/tyre/impact/wind/siren/ambience and volume/mute work preserved; audio/rotor signal/control tests passed in aggregate.
remaining: Human listening, speaker/headphone and phone audio acceptance.

name: Camera and feedback
implemented_tested: Prior frame-independent chase smoothing/reduced-motion/boost presentation preserved; camera tests and Home pixel identity passed.

name: Police encounters
implemented_tested: R3.10 obstruction-aware ground sight, capture/recovery rules and two-officer flow preserved; capture/grip/visibility suites passed.
remaining: Encounter variation and scenery-aware pedestrian staging beyond car-clear paths; no full scenery navmesh.

name: Race balance and replay
implemented_tested: Existing routes/challenges, escape qualification, once-only coins and saved progress preserved; race/Story/reward suites passed. No new modes or rewards.
remaining: Player-led challenge/reward/replay balance and evidence of replay value; no speculative retuning.

name: HUD, menus and onboarding
implemented_tested: Approved UI/main/CSS unchanged; Home desktop/mobile screenshots have zero differing pixels. Last Light objective now accurately describes an untimed pursuit; exact source-preimage proof and affected tests passed.

name: Performance and reliability
implemented_tested: 66-stage aggregate, six post-copy checks, eight ABBA render cases, builds/integrity and preserved save/error recovery checks. GPU costs and 33.3 ms pacing disclosed.
remaining: Physical phone, Safari, startup/long-session thermals and broader interruption/network/device testing.

name: Genuine player feedback
implemented_tested: No fabricated players, ratings or acceptance results.
remaining: Genuine new-player sessions and resulting iteration; no 9/10 claim.
